records.jp: 香織？　大丈夫？
records.en_original: Kaori, are you okay?
records.en_auxiliary: Kaori, are you okay?
records.en: Kaori, are you okay?

records.jp: うん……。ありがとう
records.en_original: Yeah, thanks to you.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, thanks to you.
records.en: Yeah, thanks to you.

records.jp: ううん。少しわかったから、香織の気持ち
records.en_original: Not at all. It let me understand you a little better.
records.en_auxiliary: Not at all. It let me understand you a little better.
records.en: Not at all. It let me understand you a little better.

records.jp: 香織……
records.en_original: Kaori...
records.en_auxiliary: Kaori...
records.en: Kaori...

records.jp: ……大丈夫だよ
records.en_original: ...I'm okay.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I'm okay.
records.en: ...I'm okay.

records.jp: ……あの鈍足だった梨佳があたしより速くなってて<CR>少し複雑な気持ちだっただけ
records.en_original: ...It just bruised my ego to learn how much faster you are than me, Rika.
records.en_auxiliary: ...It just bruised my ego to learn how much faster you are than me, Rika.
records.en: ...It just bruised my ego to learn how much faster you are than me, Rika.

records.jp: 香織……
records.en_original: Hey...
records.en_auxiliary: Kaori...
records.en: Hey...

records.jp: ……私が速くなれたのはね、香織のおかげなんだよ？
records.en_original: ...You know that you're the reason I got this fast, right?
records.en_auxiliary: ...You know that you're the reason I got this fast, right?
records.en: ...You know that you're the reason I got this fast, right?

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: もともと香織が誘ってくれて、いろいろ教えてくれたから、<CR>今もこうして続けてられる
records.en_original: I'm only doing what I'm doing because you invited me to track and took me under your wing.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm only doing what I'm doing because you invited me to track and took me under your wing.
records.en: I'm only doing what I'm doing because you invited me to track and took me under your wing.

records.jp: あ、あたしは……
records.en_original: I was...
records.en_auxiliary: I-I just...
records.en: I was...

records.jp: それに……それだけじゃないんだよ
records.en_original: And that's not all.
records.en_auxiliary: And that's not all.
records.en: And that's not all.

records.jp: 香織……覚えてる？　中学で、タイムが伸び悩んでいた私に<CR>香織が言ってくれたこと
records.en_original: Kaori, do you remember what you told me when I was struggling to improve my speed?
records.en_auxiliary: Kaori, do you remember what you told me when I was struggling to improve my speed?
records.en: Kaori, do you remember what you told me when I was struggling to improve my speed?

records.jp: え、な、何だったっけ……？
records.en_original: No, I... What did I tell you?
records.en_auxiliary: No, I... What did I tell you?
records.en: No, I... What did I tell you?

records.jp: あんたが遅いのは、体重が落とせてないからだって
records.en_original: You told me that I was slow because I wasn't losing any weight.
records.en_auxiliary: You told me that I was slow because I wasn't losing any weight.
records.en: You told me that I was slow because I wasn't losing any weight.

records.jp: いくら部活で走っても、終わった後にそれだけお菓子を食べてたら<CR>意味ないだろって
records.en_original: That no matter how hard I ran in training, it was meaningless if I stuffed my face with snacks after.
records.en_auxiliary: That no matter how hard I ran in training, it was meaningless if I stuffed my face with snacks after.
records.en: That no matter how hard I ran in training, it was meaningless if I stuffed my face with snacks after.

records.jp: さすがにあれはちょっと傷ついたなあ
records.en_original: To be honest, that kinda hurt.
records.en_auxiliary: To be honest, that kinda hurt.
records.en: To be honest, that kinda hurt.

records.jp: う……ご、ごめん
records.en_original: Oh... I'm so sorry.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh... I'm so sorry.
records.en: Oh... I'm so sorry.

records.jp: いいっていいって。<CR>確かにあの時の私は食事のバランスとか全然気にしてなかったし
records.en_original: I'm over it. And to be completely honest, I wasn't paying any attention to eating healthy at the time.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm over it. And to be completely honest, I wasn't paying any attention to eating healthy at the time.
records.en: I'm over it. And to be completely honest, I wasn't paying any attention to eating healthy at the time.

records.jp: たぶん、他のみんなも同じこと思ってたんだろうけど、<CR>はっきり言ってくれたのは香織だけだった
records.en_original: I think everyone on our team thought the same thing, but you were the only one who said it to my face.
records.en_auxiliary: I think everyone on our team thought the same thing, but you were the only one who said it to my face.
records.en: I think everyone on our team thought the same thing, but you were the only one who said it to my face.

records.jp: そのことが私、嬉しかったの……
records.en_original: And that honesty made me kind of happy...
records.en_auxiliary: And that honesty made me kind of happy...
records.en: And that honesty made me kind of happy...

records.jp: ……だから、私もはっきり言うね
records.en_original: ...So I'm going to be honest with YOU now.
records.en_auxiliary: ...So I'm going to be honest with YOU now.
records.en: ...So I'm going to be honest with YOU now.

records.jp: 今の香織は――見てられない
records.en_original: I can't bear to see you like this, Kaori.
records.en_auxiliary: I can't bear to see you like this, Kaori.
records.en: I can't bear to see you like this, Kaori.

records.jp: まだ陸上に未練があるんでしょ？　走りたいんでしょ？<CR>香織を見てれば、それくらい分かるよ
records.en_original: Admit it or not, you haven't gotten over running. It's plain to see just looking at you.
records.en_auxiliary: Admit it or not, you haven't gotten over running. It's plain to see just looking at you.
records.en: Admit it or not, you haven't gotten over running. It's plain to see just looking at you.

records.jp: だったら……もう一度、一緒に陸上、やろうよ……！
records.en_original: So, let's run together again. Just one more time!
records.en_auxiliary: So, let's run together again. Just one more time!
records.en: So, let's run together again. Just one more time!

records.jp: 梨佳……
records.en_original: Rika...
records.en_auxiliary: Rika...
records.en: Rika...

records.jp: それに……やっぱり香織がいないの寂しいよ……
records.en_original: Besides, it's really lonely not having you with me.
records.en_auxiliary: Besides, it's really lonely not having you with me.
records.en: Besides, it's really lonely not having you with me.

records.jp: 別に、梨佳は一人じゃない。<CR>他の仲間もいるでしょ？
records.en_original: It's not like you're alone. You have other friends, right?
records.en_auxiliary: It's not like you're alone. You have other friends, right?
records.en: It's not like you're alone. You have other friends, right?

records.jp: だけど……！
records.en_original: But...!
records.en_auxiliary: But...!
records.en: But...!

records.jp: まあでも……ありがとう。考えとく……
records.en_original: Well...thanks. I'll think about it.
records.en_auxiliary: Well...thanks. I'll think about it.
records.en: Well...thanks. I'll think about it.

records.jp: ！<CR>……うん。約束だよ
records.en_original: ! <CR>That's a promise, in my book.
records.en_auxiliary: ...! That's a promise in my book.
records.en: ! <CR>That's a promise, in my book.

records.jp: ……素直じゃないなあ
records.en_original: ...You really should just be honest.
records.en_auxiliary: ...You really should just be honest.
records.en: ...You really should just be honest.

records.jp: う、うっさい……
records.en_original: Sh-Shut up...!
records.en_auxiliary: Sh-shut up...!
records.en: Sh-Shut up...!

records.jp: もう、大丈夫だね
records.en_original: So, seems like that about wraps this up.
records.en_auxiliary: So, seems like that about wraps this up.
records.en: So, seems like that about wraps this up.

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: It does.
records.en_auxiliary: It does.
records.en: It does.

records.jp: ああやってはっきりと、思っていることを言い合えるのが、<CR>うわべだけじゃない本当の友達なのかもしれないね
records.en_original: I guess this is what true friendship is all about. Being honest and direct with each other, even when it's difficult.
records.en_auxiliary: I guess this is what true friendship is all about. Being honest and direct with each other, even when it's difficult.
records.en: I guess this is what true friendship is all about. Being honest and direct with each other, even when it's difficult.

records.jp: ……うん。ユズたちも、ヒナちゃんと、本当の友達になりたいよ
records.en_original: ...Yeah. That's what we'll have to do if we want to become true friends with Hina, too.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Yeah. That's what we'll have to do if we want to become true friends with Hina, too.
records.en: ...Yeah. That's what we'll have to do if we want to become true friends with Hina, too.

records.jp: そう、だね……
records.en_original: So it seems...
records.en_auxiliary: So it seems...
records.en: So it seems...

records.jp: 二人とも、ありがとね
records.en_original: Thank you, you two.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you, you two.
records.en: Thank you, you two.

records.jp: ヒナちゃんも。お疲れさま
records.en_original: Right back at you, Hina! Nice work.
records.en_auxiliary: Right back at you, Hina! Nice work.
records.en: Right back at you, Hina! Nice work.

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah...
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: どうしたの、ヒナちゃん？
records.en_original: What's wrong, Hina?
records.en_auxiliary: What's wrong, Hina?
records.en: What's wrong, Hina?

records.jp: 香織がうらやましいって思っただけ
records.en_original: I just felt a little jealous of Kaori.
records.en_auxiliary: I just felt a little jealous of Kaori.
records.en: I just felt a little jealous of Kaori.

records.jp: 私はもう、踊れないから……
records.en_original: I can't dance anymore, but she can run...
records.en_auxiliary: I can't dance anymore, but she can run...
records.en: I can't dance anymore, but she can run...

records.jp: ヒナちゃん……
records.en_original: Hina...
records.en_auxiliary: Hina...
records.en: Hina...

records.jp: ……でもね、今はもう大丈夫。<CR>バレエを踊れなくなったけど、それだけが人生じゃない
records.en_original: ...But I'm okay now. Even if I can't dance, I see that there's more to life than ballet.
records.en_auxiliary: ...But I'm okay now. Even if I can't dance, I see that there's more to life than ballet.
records.en: ...But I'm okay now. Even if I can't dance, I see that there's more to life than ballet.

records.jp: こうしてみんなと……ユズとライムと友達になれた。<CR>それは今の私にとって、何よりも大切なことだと思うから
records.en_original: Like you two, and all of my other friends. Being able to connect with you is the most important thing of all.
records.en_auxiliary: Like you two, and all of my other friends. Being able to connect with you is the most important thing of all.
records.en: Like you two, and all of my other friends. Being able to connect with you is the most important thing of all.

records.jp: ヒナちゃん……。うん、そうだね！
records.en_original: That's right, Hina!
records.en_auxiliary: Hina... Yeah, that's right!
records.en: That's right, Hina!

records.jp: うん！
records.en_original: Indeed!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah!
records.en: Indeed!

records.jp: また、来たね。急いで準備しないと……！
records.en_original: Here it comes again. Get ready, guys!
records.en_auxiliary: Here it comes again. Get ready, guys!
records.en: Here it comes again. Get ready, guys!

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Right!
records.en_auxiliary: Right!
records.en: Right!

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Right!
records.en_auxiliary: Right!
records.en: Right!
